display.purpose: Homepage and page hero headlines only.

headline.purpose: Major section headings across marketing pages.

label.purpose: Sparse uppercase kickers; not per-section scaffolding.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Hero product frames and device compositions.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default 200ms state transitions on buttons and surfaces.

motion.name: ambient-breathe
motion.purpose: Slow haze opacity cycle on SiteAmbient backdrop.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Liquid glass pill CTA; main conversion action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Satoshi, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; padding: 10px 28px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, white 34%, #539AC6); border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklab, white 26%, #539AC6) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, #539AC6 88%, black) 100%); box-shadow: 0 10px 26px color-mix(in oklab, #539AC6 42%, transparent), 0 22px 48px rgba(6,10,20,0.12); transition: background 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklab, white 32%, #4B90BC) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, #4B90BC 90%, black) 100%); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, #539AC6 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Satoshi, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #6E6E73; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #1D1D1F; background: color-mix(in oklab, #539AC6 12%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, #539AC6 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Elevated Surface
components.description: Default marketing card with sculpted shadow stack.
components.html:
Reading desk

Feeds, read-later, and bookmarks in one calm surface.
components.css: .ds-surface { position: relative; padding: 24px; border-radius: 32px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.98); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.72) inset, 0 8px 22px rgba(6,10,20,0.07), 0 22px 52px rgba(6,10,20,0.09), 0 0 48px rgba(83,154,198,0.07); overflow: hidden; } .ds-surface::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 30% 0%, color-mix(in oklab, #539AC6 10%, transparent) 0%, transparent 55%); opacity: 0.7; pointer-events: none; } .ds-surface-title { position: relative; font-family: Satoshi, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; color: #1D1D1F; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-surface-body { position: relative; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: #6E6E73; margin: 0; max-width: 52ch; }

components.name: Feature Chip
components.description: Hero chip rail item; feature name pill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: Satoshi, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #1A5D7A; background: color-mix(in oklab, #539AC6 10%, white); border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }

components.name: Editorial Eyebrow
components.description: Sparse section kicker; use deliberately, not on every band.
components.html: A calmer home for everything you read
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: Satoshi, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #539AC6; margin: 0 0 16px; }

components.name: Floating Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation link on glass chrome.
components.html: HomeFeatures
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, rgba(255,255,255,0.64) 55%, transparent); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.46); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.35); } .ds-nav-link { padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Satoshi, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #6E6E73; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 9999px; transition: color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #1D1D1F; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #1D1D1F; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, #539AC6 70%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Cardmaniacs marketing translates the app's calm reading desk into web editorial surfaces: frosted ambient atmosphere, oversized rounded cards, pill controls, and real product imagery staged as reading objects. The system is premium and native without mimicking Apple.com or third-party reference apps. Design continuity with the iOS/macOS app is mandatory.
keyCharacteristics: Cardmaniacs blue (#539AC6) as the sole accent
Multi-layer shadows with subtle blue glow
Real app screenshots as primary visual artifacts

rules.name: The App Continuity Rule
rules.body: Marketing colors, radii, shadow vocabulary, and surface treatments must trace directly to the Cardmaniacs app chrome. When the app is unavailable as reference, preserve existing site tokens in global.css.

rules.name: The Frosted Ambient Rule
rules.body: Background depth comes from SiteAmbient (haze, bloom pools, frost veil, glint). Prohibited: full-page gradient meshes, paper-grain overlays, or warm neutral body backgrounds.

rules.name: The Accent Restraint Rule
rules.body: Cardmaniacs blue carries CTAs, focus, chips, and low-opacity washes. It must not flood large flat surfaces.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Sparingly Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked eyebrows are deliberate brand punctuation, not default section scaffolding.

rules.name: The Sculpted Object Rule
rules.body: Shadows combine inset specular highlights, ambient depth, and accent glow.

dos: Do preserve Cardmaniacs blue #539AC6 and existing global.css tokens when extending the site.
Do use SiteAmbient for site-wide atmosphere and real app imagery for proof.
Do use Motion.dev for high-value reveals; keep CSS transitions at 200–300ms.
donts: Don't ship generic SaaS landing patterns: hero metrics, identical icon-card grids, cream or sand body backgrounds, buzzword copy.
Don't clone Apple.com, Bear, Craft, or reference apps verbatim.
Don't invent new accent colors or diverge from the app's visual language.
Don't put an uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section or numbered section markers as default scaffolding.
Don't gate content visibility on scroll-reveal animations.
